phase_title: Independent Review and Alternative Evaluation Design
decision_rationale: A sensitivity-analysis protocol (Protocol C) is available that can produce scientifically defensible results without requiring acquisition-level metadata or external expert review. The protocol pre-registers a family of grouping assumptions, trains models independently under each, and reports whether tumour-versus-context reliance findings are robust across leakage assumptions. This acknowledges uncertainty rather than resolving it with unjustified claims.

conditions_for_go.description: Complete transitive closure analysis of the 236 candidate pairs at SSIM thresholds [0.80, 0.75, 0.70, 0.60] to determine group sizes and cluster structure.
Generate candidate regrouped split manifests for each scenario and verify that all three classes remain present in all folds with sufficient sample counts (minimum 50 per class per fold).
Document the complete sensitivity-analysis plan (all scenarios, grouping rules, and acceptance criteria) before any model training begins.
Verify that the existing pretraining gate passes under at least the baseline scenario (existing patient-grouped splits unchanged).
conditions_for_go.notes: The gate passes all checks except the 236 unresolved candidates. Under Protocol C, the sensitivity analysis explicitly handles this by reporting results under multiple grouping assumptions.

conditions_for_go.description: Ensure no labels, fold assignments, or patient IDs are changed in the authoritative dataset. Regrouping scenarios must be implemented as separate, versioned split manifests.
conditions_for_go.notes: All original files are preserved with verified checksums.

conditions_for_go.description: Record regrouping-scenario split manifests, their checksums, and the sensitivity-analysis plan in the experiment configuration before training.

recommended_protocol.name: Sensitivity analysis across grouping assumptions
recommended_protocol.description: Define a family of evaluation protocols parameterized by grouping threshold. Report tumour-versus-context findings under all assumptions. If findings are robust, the conclusion is defensible regardless of which pairs are genuine.

scenarios.description: Baseline: existing patient-grouped 5-fold split, no regrouping
Conservative grouping: Tier 1 only (SSIM >= 0.80, 2 pairs, ~4 patients regrouped)
Full conservative grouping: all 236 candidate pairs
Maximum exclusion: remove all 291 samples involved in any candidate pair

secondary_recommendation.name: Independent expert review (parallel track)
secondary_recommendation.description: If an independent reviewer becomes available, their pair-level decisions can narrow the sensitivity range and strengthen conclusions. The expert review package and decision template are prepared.

unresolved_limitations: Acquisition-level metadata (DICOM headers, volume identifiers) are unavailable and unlikely to be obtained.
PID reliability cannot be independently verified without dataset-provider confirmation.
PID suffix variants (e.g., MR024780B vs MR024780G) may represent same-patient records but cannot be confirmed.
The cvind.mat file-to-index mapping remains unverified and is not used.
The pHash screening threshold (Hamming <= 4/64) may miss related pairs with higher distances.
No model has been trained; sensitivity analysis results are unknown until training is performed.
Expert review has not been performed; the reviewer template and package are prepared but unfilled.
prohibited_actions: No model training occurred during this phase.
No source files, metadata, labels, patient IDs, or fold assignments were modified.
No pair was labeled as a confirmed duplicate or confirmed non-duplicate.
No protocol was selected to optimize expected accuracy.
No reviewer, review date, or review decision was invented.

existing_tests_passed.details: 7 duplicate-investigation tests and 8 finalization tests — all passed
